newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's Valkarton to list its shares on OTC.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's Valkarton to list its shares on OTC.

text.p: Slovenian cardboard producer Valkarton will list its shares on the over-the-counter (OTC) segment of the Ljubljana Stock Exchange on June 26, the Ljubljana bourse said on Tuesday.
The company will list 597,025 shares, or 63.05 percent of its equity. The shares have a nominal value of 1,000 tolars ($6.6) each.
Valkarton joins a batch of 29 companies that have been listed on the main or OTC segments of Ljubljana bourse since the beginning of last year.
Currently there are 28 issues traded on the main market and 41 on the OTC market. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
